steps.title: Setup Web Project Structure and Tailwind CSS Integration
steps.description: Initialize standard HTML base layout with Tailwind CSS v4 CDN and glassmorphic UI container elements.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata and Backend API Schema
steps.description: Define app identifiers, generic generic worker database collections for garage unlocks and leaderboards, and scoring business logic.

steps.title: Design Futuristic HUD and Dynamic Dashboard UI
steps.description: Create responsive 3D racing HUD with digital speedometer, radial tachometer, gear display, nitro energy bar, and mini-map frame.

steps.title: Implement WebGL/Canvas 3D Graphics Engine Core
steps.description: Develop high-performance 3D projection renderer with dynamic camera matrix, horizon clipping, road meshing, and curved terrain projection.

steps.title: Build Vehicle Dynamic Physics and Control Handlers
steps.description: Program physics model covering engine RPM, acceleration curves, momentum, brake weight transfer, drifting, and collision bouncing.

steps.title: Implement AI Competitor Racers and Collision Logic
steps.description: Create dynamic opponent AI cars with intelligent overtake behavior, distance tracking, and vehicle-to-vehicle physics response.

steps.title: Construct Web Audio API Procedural Sound Engine
steps.description: Synthesize real-time engine rev audio, turbo blow-offs, tire screeching, collision thuds, nitro thrust, and retro synthwave soundscapes.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Garage and Car Customization Studio
steps.description: Implement interactive 3D car rotation preview, color painting, spoiler dynamic tuning, wheel rim selection, and engine performance upgrades.

steps.title: Create Environment Themes, Tunnels, and Weather FX
steps.description: Build diverse track themes including Neon Cyber City, Alpine Sunset Pass, Tokyo Coastal Highway, and Night Rain with particle spray.

steps.title: Integrate Cloud Backend Client & User Authentication
steps.description: Connect user login, registration, password OTP recovery, high-score cloud sync, and global leaderboard data processing.

steps.title: Develop Local Offline Scoring & Statistics Calculation
steps.description: Implement browser-side real-time calculation for drift score bonuses, lap split times, speed averages, and race score evaluation.

steps.title: Add On-Screen Touch Controls & Mobile Responsiveness
steps.description: Incorporate virtual steering touch wheel, analog acceleration touch pads, and responsive UI scaling for mobile devices.

steps.title: Building apex3dracer
steps.description: Perform final performance optimization, particle pooling, canvas render loop verification, and full game release build.
